simulation_envelope.rationale: Effort is capped at 50.6% of the documented 23.7 Nm peak and speed at one third of the documented 30 rad/s maximum. These are simulation safety bounds, not continuous ratings.
simulation_envelope.joint_limit_rationale: Conservative simulation motion envelopes selected to prevent full rotation and self-intersection while the physical hard-stop geometry remains unmeasured. They must not be used as hardware hard limits.

derived_collision.sole_center_rationale: Each XY center is the mean of source-mesh vertices within 1 mm of the local minimum Z. Center Z is minimum Z plus the 18 mm sole radius so the derived sphere bottom preserves the source-mesh tip height.
